cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which suggests we've identified a staffing problem, not an individual error.

mechanism: A supervises an invitation correction by assigning the wrong address to archive, verification and staffing failures rather than personal error.
confusable: Ordinary problem solving can acknowledge error; D181 must obscure A's role through distributed process responsibility.
comparison: Domestic mailing repair differs from transport incident reporting.
seedUse: Keep old-address accusation and A-as-archive reveal, making the final staffing claim affect what B must do next.
